attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2026), processed by ESA; Element 84 Earth Search / AWS.
processing: Bilinear geographic reprojection; luminance (median gain, soft shoulder above 150) and chroma (mean/spread) matched to the Yandex satellite captures over 53008 shared land pixels (gain 2.251, chroma scale [0.722, 0.424]); 24566 bright roof, tent and gravel pixels (under 10 m, where the model has its own buildings) filled from the surrounding ground; WebP. No sharpening, no generative enhancement.
